channel.title: Musfira AI free tools
channel.description: New free tools from Musfira AI free tools

item.title: Reverse Text
item.description: Reverse text by characters, by words or by lines in your browser, with correct handling of accents and symbols.

item.title: Remove Extra Spaces
item.description: Remove double spaces, trim the ends of lines, delete blank lines and turn tabs into spaces, in your browser.

item.title: Sort Lines
item.description: Sort a list of lines from A to Z or Z to A, ignore case, trim spaces, skip empty lines and remove repeats, all in your browser.

item.title: Remove Line Breaks
item.description: Join text onto one line by removing line breaks, with options to keep paragraphs and to use a space, a comma or nothing.

item.title: Slug Generator
item.description: Turn any title into a clean, lowercase URL slug with accents removed and your choice of hyphens or underscores.

item.title: URL Encoder and Decoder
item.description: Percent-encode or decode text and web addresses in your browser, for a single value or a whole address.

item.title: Base64 Encoder and Decoder
item.description: Encode text to Base64 or decode Base64 back to text in your browser, with URL-safe output and full Unicode support.

item.title: Text Case Converter
item.description: Change text to upper, lower, title or sentence case, or to camelCase, snake_case, kebab-case and more, in your browser.

item.title: Word Counter
item.description: Count words, characters, sentences and reading time as you type, with live limits for posts, messages and search snippets.

item.title: Password Generator
item.description: Create strong random passwords in your browser, with adjustable length, character sets and an honest strength estimate.

item.title: Loan EMI Calculator
item.description: Work out your monthly loan payment, total interest and year-by-year balance, and see how an extra monthly payment shortens the loan.

item.title: JSON Formatter
item.description: Format, minify and validate JSON in your browser, with exact large numbers, sorted keys and the line and column of the first error.
